articles.summary: A plain-English technical guide to propensity scores for survival RWE, using a post-MI statin example to explain matching, weighting, estimands, survival curves, balance checks, and sensitivity analysis.
articles.title: Propensity Scores for Survival Outcomes: What RWE Teams Should Report

articles.summary: External controls can help rare disease and oncology teams answer questions that a conventional randomized trial cannot always reach. The hard part is proving that the comparison is fair.
articles.title: When the Control Arm Comes From the Real World

articles.summary: A practical walkthrough of causal inference for RWE: why naive comparisons fail, how DAGs clarify assumptions, and how target trial emulation turns messy data into a credible study design.
articles.title: Causal Inference in Real-World Evidence: From DAGs to Target Trials

articles.summary: Randomized trials remain essential, but they leave major gaps around real-world effectiveness, patient variation, and value. Real-world evidence is how teams close them.
articles.title: RCTs Tell You If a Drug Can Work. RWE Tells You If It Will.
